name: wormhole-vector
description: A single-file C functional model (`vec.c`, ~43 KB) of the Tensix vector unit (SFPU) instruction set on Wormhole, written as the companion to Part 6 of Peter Cawley's Tenstorrent Wormhole blog series. It models the 32-lane vector registers, per-lane flags and flag stack, the lane PRNG and `Dst` access, and marks undefined behaviour explicitly, including observed hardware quirks such as the fast-and-loose fp16-to-fp32 conversion path. It is a reverse-engineered description, not an official specification; later fixes were contributed by Jason Davies.
